title: Characteristic function of a correlated Gaussian
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $t=(t_1,t_2)\in\mathbb R^2$. The characteristic function of the correlated Gaussian probability measure with correlation parameter $\rho$, evaluated at $t$, is $\displaystyle \exp\!\left(-\frac{t_1^2+2\rho t_1t_2+t_2^2}{2}\right)$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is a point of the real correlation plane
